column3: “Belongs to” and “as one” expand the repeated Greek expression “from the earth.”
The Greek connects the clauses with “and,” rather than “yet.”
The second “God” supplies the unnamed subject; “without limit” renders “not by measure.”
The Greek has singular “hand,” not plural “hands.”
ἀπειθῶν denotes disobedience or refusal to obey; BSB renders this as rejecting the Son.
